title: Towards Chinese Yue Opera Singing Voice Synthesis: A Benchmark with Dataset, Data Augmentation and Baseline Model
abstract: This paper establishes the first comprehensive benchmark for Singing Voice Synthesis (SVS) of Chinese Yue Opera in the Wu dialect, addressing a critical gap in this unexplored field. Our benchmark integrates three key components: (1) the Yue Opera Audio-Text (YOAT) dataset, a high-quality corpus of 565 studio recordings with phoneme-level alignments for duration and pitch; (2) targeted data augmentation methods from the perspectives of pronunciation and pitch; and (3) YueOpera-Singer, a strong baseline model built on conditional flow-matching. Comprehensive objective and subjective evaluations verify the reliability of the YOAT dataset and the effectiveness of the proposed data augmentation methods. YueOpera-Singer delivers competitive synthesis quality with a subjective MOS of 3.92, acting as a robust baseline for the benchmark. The dataset, code, and demo samples are publicly available on the https://anonymous.4open.science/api/repo/YueOpera_Benchmark-6914/file/index.html.
relevance_note: First Yue Opera singing voice synthesis benchmark with dataset, augmentation methods and baseline model; core singing synthesis contribution.
